text_block_list.text:
—The day has finally arrived for the grand 
finale of the Senior Class, the Arima 
Kinen!

For Nice Nature, this is a very, very... 
important race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah... wait, before that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "*Ahem*. ...May I have your attention?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I'm going to say something embarrassing 
now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for pulling me all the way 
here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I thought my dreams were so far away. Even 
though I'd never even run toward them.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's different now. Because I already know 
that dreams are something you have to 
seize for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—"Something's just not quite there." 
That's just who I am.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can get into a good position, but from 
there, it just doesn't translate into a 
win.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"This race was supposed to be my chance to 
show what I can do. And now Teio's joining 
in too...? Come on, what gives!"

The timid girl from when we first met is 
no longer here. The way she is now, she 
will surely—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm... gonna go sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――I'm gonna bring home the shiniest trophy 
for you, Trainer!

A gathering of titans at this year's Arima 
Kinen. Among them, the one glaring 
intently at Nice Nature was—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Nature, I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well? What you said back then... If it's 
now, you can still take it back!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, is dat so? Then I won't hold back...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...That's probably what the old me 
would've said.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not taking it back. I'll say it 
as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ――That I'm gonna beat you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Ahahaha! Now that's what I'm talking 
about!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright Nature, let's race! If you've 
forgotten, I'll teach you as many times as 
it takes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The strength of the invincible Lord Teio, 
that is!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Something like that. I already know it 
all too well, to the point of disgust."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I... I have 'great potential' too, 
right?”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Trainer... I know it best of 
all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's why I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The main character of the Arima Kinen is 
gonna be ME!
